# What does your open bond book owe if defendants miss court?

> Free tool for bail bond agents: enter your open bonds, collateral and surety terms to see net premium, the loss if bonds are forfeited, whether cash covers the largest ones, and a court-date call list. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/bail-bond-agency-exposure-calculator/)
